lead.zh: 这是示例日刊，用来演示上午与下午写在同一个文件里。这些条目不是真实报道。
lead.en: Sample day showing morning and afternoon in one file. These items are not real reporting.

title.zh: 示例：实验室公布一项评测
title.en: Sample: a lab publishes an evaluation

summary.zh: 占位条目，说明一份评测。详情页有更完整的译文，并链回来源。
summary.en: Placeholder about an evaluation, with a longer body on the detail page and a link back to the source.

body.zh:
这条只用来演示更完整的详情页，不是报道。

正文可以带上从来源整理来的几段话，也可以有列表：

- 一条标明为示例的占位结论。
- 指向[示例来源](https://example.com/tech-eval)的链接。

**朝夕不是这段文字的原发布者。**
body.en:
This sample is only here to show a longer detail page. It is not a report.

The body can carry a few paragraphs brought over from a source, plus a list:

- A placeholder finding, clearly labeled as a sample.
- A link to the [sample source](https://example.com/tech-eval).

**Zhaoxi did not originate this text.**

summary.zh: 占位简讯，演示中文原文配英文翻译。详情页保留稍长的正文和来源。
summary.en: Placeholder brief. The original is Chinese, with an English translation and a longer body.

body.zh:
原文是中文。阅读界面是英文时，默认显示翻译，并标出翻译图标。

- 第一条是占位。
- 来源见[示例公报](https://example.com/summit-note)。
body.en:
The original is Chinese. An English UI shows this translation by default, with the translation icon.

- The first point is a placeholder.
- The source is the [sample communique](https://example.com/summit-note).

title.zh: 示例：出口清单上的一条占位
title.en: Sample: one line on an export list

summary.zh: 商业占位，中英标题和摘要都有，但没有长正文。详情页只显示摘要和来源。
summary.en: Market placeholder with both languages and no long body, so the detail page is the summary plus sources.

summary.zh: 只有中文、没有译文，因此卡片上不显示翻译开关。这是示例，不是报道。

title.zh: 示例：下午发布的实验记录

summary.zh: 下午的占位条目，写在同一天的 pm 里，用来出现在上午卡片的下方。
summary.en: Afternoon placeholder stored in pm of the same file, so it renders under the morning cards.

body.zh:
下午的稿追加到**同一个** `2026-10-27.json`，不要新建第二个文件。

详见[示例记录](https://example.com/lab-release)。
body.en:
Afternoon copy is appended to the **same** `2026-10-27.json`. Do not create a second file.

See the [sample note](https://example.com/lab-release).

summary.zh: 下午的中文短条目，带英文翻译，没有长正文。
summary.en: A short afternoon item in Chinese, with an English translation and no long body.
